description: Find and read research datasets on Dryad, the nonprofit open data repository: search by words, author or ORCID iD, institution, funder, journal and date, find the datasets behind an article, get a dataset's authors, abstract, funding, related works and citation, list its versions and files with download links, and find files by checksum. Start a workflow when a new dataset is published or a dataset gets a new version. No account or API key required.

dryad_new_dataset_trigger.description: Runs when a new dataset is published on Dryad, optionally only one matching search words, an institution, a keyword, a funder, a journal or an author, with its DOI, title, authors, abstract, size, related article and citation. New versions of older datasets don't start it. Checks every 15 minutes.
